name: 腾讯会议 AI 托管
name_zh: 腾讯会议 AI 托管
desc: Tencent Meeting mode where Yuanbao attends in your place
desc_zh: 腾讯会议里让元宝替你入会的功能
solves: Missing the start of a meeting leaves you asking colleagues what happened; Yuanbao joins instead and writes the notes.
solves_zh: 错过会议开头只能回头问同事，现在让元宝代替你入会，纪要它来写。
best_for: Two meetings overlap, or you are stuck in transit, and one of them still has to be heard.
best_for_zh: 两个会撞期，或者你还在路上，但其中一个必须有人听完整场。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://meeting.tencent.com/support/version, https://meeting.tencent.com/new）。 Backfill: in-product surface of 腾讯会议, absent from the ledger. The official news post is dated 2025-09-11 and states the feature went live that day; the V3.38.0 changelog entry (2025-10-25) restates it with the release tagline, so the news post is used for the date. Entry point is the AI 托管 tab under 会议AI at https://meeting.tencent.com/ai. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：官方新闻稿的叫法是「腾讯会议联合元宝全新推出的 AI 托管功能」；只写「AI 托管」在卡片上指代不明。 首次公开日期来源：https://meeting.tencent.com/news/aitg20250904.html
